name: Make the tests pass (Python)
summary: The executor edits solution.py until a hidden pytest suite passes. Score = percentage of tests passing. A good template for code-correctness tasks.

executor.task: Edit ONLY solution.py to make the hidden tests pass. Do not create other files. One focused change per step.

validator.goal: Review the change: your opinion on the approach, which behaviour is still failing and why, and one or two concrete fixes to try next.
